title: Expose the common-reference quotient as Samplinglib's canonical real RN density
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Theorem 8.3.1 proof: after writing both laws relative to one reference measure, the proof uses the real density ratio rho = p/q; Samplinglib's canonical real RN representative is RNLogRatio.density = (rnDeriv).toReal.
target_statement: From ASTIS-SW-common-reference-rn-quotient, prove that RNLogRatio.density (m.withDensity p) (m.withDensity q) equals p.toReal / q.toReal almost everywhere with respect to m.withDensity q. Reuse ENNReal.toReal_div and introduce no additional analytic hypotheses.
consumers: ASTIS theorem-fidelity round trip for the simultaneous f-divergence theorem

searched: Samplinglib main: RNLogRatio.density is already the canonical real RN representative
Parent #228: canonical ENNReal common-reference RN quotient
Pinned Mathlib Data/ENNReal/Inv.lean: [simp] ENNReal.toReal_div is unconditional
Samplinglib branches/Frontier Cells: no existing adapter from #228-style quotient to RNLogRatio.density
shared_floor_audit.notes: This cell contains no new measure theory. It only transports the already-canonical ENNReal RN identity through Samplinglib's chosen real representative. Keeping it named makes the source proof's p/q notation and the theorem statement's dmu/dnu notation one explicit graph edge rather than an informal identification. The exact child theorem and focused check passed immediately; the same head also passed the full ASTIS gate and site build.
